gloss: as one wishes; just as one pleases; to one's heart's content

definitions.gloss: as one wishes; just as one pleases; freely and without restraint
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something exactly the way one wants, without interference or restriction. Can be used positively (freedom, self-expression) or negatively (selfishness, unchecked behavior).

examples.japanese: {思|おも}うがままに{生|い}きる。
{彼|かれ}は{思|おも}うがままに{行動|こうどう}して{周|まわ}りを{困|こま}らせた。
examples.english: He acted as he pleased and caused trouble for those around him.

examples.japanese: {退職|たいしょく}したら、{思|おも}うがままに{旅|たび}をして{過|す}ごしたい。
examples.english: After I retire, I want to spend my time traveling wherever I please.

notes:
The がまま pattern means "as is" or "in accordance with." {思|おも}うがまま literally means "as one thinks/wishes." Often followed by the particle に to form an adverbial phrase ({思|おも}うがままに). The expression has a literary flavor and is common in written Japanese, speeches, and proverbs.

RELATED PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}うがままに: as one wishes (adverbial)
- {思|おも}うがままにする: to do as one pleases
- {思|おも}うがままになる: to go as one wishes; to be at one's disposal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}り: as one expected; as one wanted — focuses on outcomes matching expectations
- {好|す}き{勝手|かって}: doing whatever one likes — more colloquial and usually negative
- {自由|じゆう}に: freely — neutral, lacks the literary nuance
- {気|き}の{向|む}くまま: on a whim; as the mood takes one — emphasizes spontaneity over will
